args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Retail returns logistics — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Saltmarsh Foods newsletter, its linked article (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns), and the companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates have reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
